title: 2025 Integrated Report

body_markdown:
##### 2025 Integrated Report


We are proud to present our 2025 Integrated Report, highlighting how we create long-term value across Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay.


At Adecoagro, we leverage on natural resources to produce food and renewable energy through efficient and sustainable models that drive returns and unlock value.


By combining innovation, technology and responsible resource management, we continue strengthening our operations while generating a positive impact on society and the environment.
